reviews.title: Combat seasonal depression
reviews.text: Not even kidding when I say that this app is just right. Super easy to set up my routine checklists - if I’m struggling, only the basics are required and don’t kill my garden for a missed day! When I’m feeling great, up the expectations and my gardens flourish! I love that I was able to purchase the app instead of being a monthly subscription.

reviews.title: Simple
reviews.text: I really like this app. It’s simple and not like the pet apps. I’ve only been using it for 2 days and I really like watching the flower grow already. The free customizations are nice too. Only downside to the free option is you have limited goals, but the sub is cheap and even offers a lifetime access which I do plan to purchase in the future. This app has helped me stay on track with small simple habits coming fresh out of a psychiatric care unit. Thanks devs!

~~ update
I still enjoy this app even though I’ve fallen off. I use it more as the widget to see what’s pending. 
Based on my first review - i can see a yearly outline and see how I’m doing for the year in a single view. It gets the job done. I can say even though I’m not using this app daily anymore - i still appreciate it and still come back to it when i feel I’m falling off. 
I appreciate its relaxing music as well. 

Original review:

reviews.title: Love this app!!!
reviews.text: I really like this app it’s super clean the graphics are amazing and most importantly it really kept me on track with my goals. I used this to help me stay on top of schoolwork because I was using another app to help with habits (I know it’s confusing but I needed a separate space to keep track of my school stuff so it didn’t look like I had so many things I needed to do and so I could have a not cluttered school workspace) and it worked really great for that the only thing I would say is that you need to have premium to have over 5 goals I think? Which is a little annoying to me because if I tracked habits on here I wouldn’t be able to have enough checks but overall love the app!!!
